hits.asked: vegetable patch ke chaaron taraf fencing karni ho—fencing ke liye kya naapenge: andar ki jagah ya bahar ki boundary? Hea
hits.reply: Bilkul, 160 m perimeter hai—rectangle ki chaaron sides jodkar boundary milti hai. Ab square ki sides kaise jodenge?

hits.label: q2
hits.asked: 50 m aur 30 m par lagaiye. Hear
